items.title: File Widerspruch against the Arbeitsunfall decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated and presumably posted on Friday 20.11.2026; no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is given, so the posting day is 20.11.2026. The letter itself states the delivery fiction rule: 'Schicken wir Ihnen den Bescheid mit der Post, ist er am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden bekannt gegeben (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X).' Counting the 4th day after 20.11.2026: Sat 21.11 (day1), Sun 22.11 (day2), Mon 23.11 (day3), Tue 24.11 (day4) → deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on 24.11.2026. As this is a social-law body (gesetzliche Unfallversicherung, § 37 SGB X), the delivery day does not move even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (here it is a Tuesday anyway). The one-month Widerspruch period under § 84 SGG/§ 37 SGB X starts the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 25.11.2026, and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 24.12.2026. 24 December is a working day (not a public holiday, per the stated rule that 24 and 31 December are working days) and falls on a Thursday, so no weekend/holiday extension (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X) is needed. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
